fails.src:
\
  at [[MATH_3]]\,TeV in 2012.  Individual searches in the channels
  \htollll, [[MACRO_4]]\ and [[MATH_5]] in the
  8\,TeV data are combined with previously published results of
  searches for [[MATH_6]], [[MATH_7]], \bbbar\ and
  [[MATH_8]] in the 7\,TeV data and results from improved analyses of the \htollll\ and
  [[MACRO_9]]\  channels in the 7\,TeV data.  Clear evidence
  for the production of a neutral boson with a measured mass of [[MATH_10]] 
  is presented. This observation, which has a significance of 5.9 standard deviations,
  corresponding to a background fluctuation probability of [[MATH_11]], 
  is compatible with the production and decay of the Standard Model Higgs boson.
fails.zh:
\
  于2012年在[[MATH_3]]\,TeV能级下。8\,TeV数据中\htollll、[[MACRO_4]]\和[[MATH_5]]通道的单独搜寻结果，与先前发表的7\,TeV数据中对[[MATH_6]]、[[MATH_7]]、\bbbar\和[[MATH_8]]的搜寻结果，以及7\,TeV数据中\htollll\和[[MACRO_9]]\通道改进分析的结果相结合。本文给出了产生一个中性玻色子的明确证据，其测量质量为[[MATH_10]]。这一观测的显著度为5.9个标准差，对应于[[MATH_11]]的背景涨落概率，与标准模型希格斯玻色子的产生和衰变相符。

In order to account for energy losses upstream of the calorimeter and energy leakage outside of the cluster,
MC simulation results are used to calibrate the energies of the photon candidates; there are separate
calibrations for unconverted and converted candidates.
The calibration is refined by applying [[MATH_425]]-dependent correction factors,
which are of the order of [[MATH_426]], determined from measured [[MACRO_427]]\ events. 
The leading (sub-leading) photon candidate is required to have [[MATH_428]]~GeV (30~GeV).
fails.zh: 为了考虑量能器上游的能量损失和簇外的能量泄漏，使用MC模拟结果来校准光子候选者的能量；对未转换和已转换的候选者分别进行校准。通过应用依赖于[[MATH_425]]的修正因子来改进校准，这些修正因子的量级为[[MATH_426]]，由测量的[[MACRO_427]]\事件确定。要求领头（次领头）光子候选者具有[[MATH_428]]~GeV（30~GeV）。

fails.src:
The processes producing the majority of same-charge dilepton events,
\Wjets, [[MATH_716]] and [[MATH_717]], are
all backgrounds in the opposite-charge signal region. 
\Wjets{} and [[MACRO_718]]{} backgrounds are particularly important in a search optimised for a low Higgs
boson mass hypothesis.  Therefore, the normalisation and kinematic features of 
same-charge dilepton events are used to validate the predictions of these backgrounds.
The predicted number of same-charge events 
after the \metrel\ and zero-jet requirements
is 216 [[MATH_719]] 7 (stat) [[MATH_720]] 42 (syst), while 182 events are observed in the data. 
Satisfactory agreement between data and simulation is observed in various kinematic distributions, including those of 
[[MATH_721]] (see Fig.~[[REF_722]](a)) and the transverse mass.
fails.zh:
产生大部分同号双轻子事件的过程，即\Wjets、[[MATH_716]]和[[MATH_717]]，在异号信号区中均为背景。
\Wjets{}和[[MACRO_718]]{}背景在针对低希格斯玻色子质量假设优化的搜索中尤为重要。因此，同号双轻子事件的归一化和运动学特征被用于验证对这些背景的预测。
在\metrel\和零喷注要求之后，预测的同号事件数为216 [[MATH_719]] 7（统计）[[MATH_720]] 42（系统），而数据中观察到182个事件。
在包括[[MATH_721]]（见图~[[REF_722]](a)）和横质量在内的各种运动学分布中，观察到数据与模拟之间具有令人满意的一致性。

fails.zh: [[BIBITEM_1]] Vaswani 等人 \href{https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762}{引入了 Transformer}，证明了当隐藏维度满足 [[MATH_3]] 时，仅凭注意力机制便已足够；Bahdanau、Cho 和 Bengio 的早期工作 [[CITE_2]] 以及 Luong 和 Manning 的综述 [[CITE_5]] 早已对此有所暗示。

The data are selected using single-lepton
  or dilepton triggers. For the single-muon trigger, the \pt~threshold is [[MATH_157]] for the [[MATH_158]] data
  and [[MATH_159]] for the [[MATH_160]] data, while for the
  single-electron trigger the transverse energy, \et,~threshold 
  varies from [[MATH_161]] to [[MATH_162]] for the [[MATH_163]] data 
  and is [[MATH_164]] for the [[MATH_165]] data. For the dielectron triggers, the
  thresholds are [[MATH_166]] for both electrons. For
  the dimuon triggers, the thresholds for the [[MATH_167]] data are
  [[MATH_168]] for each muon, while for the [[MATH_169]] data the thresholds are 
  [[MATH_170]]. An additional asymmetric dimuon trigger is used in the [[MATH_171]] data 
  with thresholds  [[MATH_172]] and [[MATH_173]] for the leading and sub-leading muon, respectively.
fails.zh: 数据使用单轻子或双轻子触发器进行选择。对于单μ子触发器，[[MATH_158]]数据的\pt阈值为[[MATH_157]]，[[MATH_160]]数据的阈值为[[MATH_159]]；而对于单电子触发器，[[MATH_163]]数据的横向能量\et阈值在[[MATH_161]]到[[MATH_162]]之间变化，[[MATH_165]]数据的阈值为[[MATH_164]]。对于双电子触发器，两个电子的阈值均为[[MATH_166]]。对于双μ子触发器，[[MATH_167]]数据中每个μ子的阈值为[[MATH_168]]，而[[MATH_169]]数据的阈值为[[MATH_170]]。在[[MATH_171]]数据中还使用了一个额外的非对称双μ子触发器，其前导和次前导μ子的阈值分别为[[MATH_172]]和[[MATH_173]]。
